public.text: AI readiness is organised into data, legal and policy, and institutional capacity. The framework omits technical infrastructure, cybersecurity, procurement capability, clinical evidence, workforce readiness, financing, and change management.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the readiness framework or define these as subdimensions of institutional capacity. Include computing, integration, security, evidence, operations, financing, procurement, and user readiness.
